mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_user u WHERE u.USER_ID = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT}
SELECT * FROM sys_user u WHERE u.user_name = #{userName}
SELECT * FROM sys_user u WHERE u.description = #{description}
SELECT u.user_id ,u.user_name ,u.status ,u.description FROM sys_user u WHERE u.USER_ID = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT}

SELECT SU.* FROM FCT_CONTRACT FC JOIN FCT_PROJECT FP ON FC.PROJECT_ID=FP.PROJECT_ID JOIN SYS_USER_ALLOCATION SUA ON SUA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID=FP.PROJECT_ASSISTANT_ASSIGNS_ID JOIN SYS_USER SU ON SU.USER_ID=SUA.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND FC.CONTRACT_ID=#{contractId} UNION SELECT SU.* FROM FCT_CONTRACT FC JOIN FCT_PROJECT FP ON FC.PROJECT_ID=FP.PROJECT_ID JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS FEA ON FEA.EMPLOYEE_ID=FP.EMPLOYEE_ID JOIN SYS_USER_ALLOCATION SUA ON SUA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID=FEA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID JOIN SYS_USER SU ON SU.USER_ID=SUA.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND FC.CONTRACT_ID=#{contractId} UNION
SELECT SU.* FROM CON_CONTRACT FC JOIN PRJ_PROJECT FP ON FC.PROJECT_ID=FP.PROJECT_ID JOIN SYS_USER_ALLOCATION SUA ON SUA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID=FP.PROJECT_ASSISTANT_ASSIGNS_ID JOIN SYS_USER SU ON SU.USER_ID=SUA.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND FC.CONTRACT_ID=#{contractId} UNION SELECT SU.* FROM CON_CONTRACT FC JOIN PRJ_PROJECT FP ON FC.PROJECT_ID=FP.PROJECT_ID JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS FEA ON FEA.EMPLOYEE_ID=FP.EMPLOYEE_ID JOIN SYS_USER_ALLOCATION SUA ON SUA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID=FEA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID JOIN SYS_USER SU ON SU.USER_ID=SUA.USER_ID WHERE 1=1 AND FC.CONTRACT_ID=#{contractId} UNION
SELECT SU.* FROM FND_ORG_UNIT FOU JOIN FND_ORG_POSITION FOP ON FOU.CHIEF_POSITION_ID=FOP.POSITION_ID AND FOU.ENABLED_FLAG='Y' JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS FEA ON FOP.POSITION_ID=FEA.POSITION_ID AND FOP.ENABLED_FLAG='Y' AND FEA.ENABLED_FLAG='Y' JOIN FND_COMPANY FC ON FC.COMPANY_ID=FEA.COMPANY_ID AND FC.ENABLED_FLAG='Y' JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE FE ON FE.EMPLOYEE_ID=FEA.EMPLOYEE_ID AND FE.ENABLED_FLAG='Y' JOIN SYS_USER_ALLOCATION SUA ON SUA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID=FEA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID JOIN SYS_USER SU ON SU.USER_ID=SUA.USER_ID WHERE FOU.UNIT_CODE IN ('001') AND FEA.COMPANY_ID=#{companyId} UNION SELECT SU.* FROM
FND_ORG_POSITION FOP JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS FEA ON FOP.POSITION_ID=FEA.POSITION_ID AND FOP.ENABLED_FLAG='Y' JOIN FND_COMPANY FC ON FC.COMPANY_ID=FEA.COMPANY_ID AND FC.ENABLED_FLAG='Y' JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE FE ON FE.EMPLOYEE_ID=FEA.EMPLOYEE_ID AND FE.ENABLED_FLAG='Y' JOIN SYS_USER_ALLOCATION SUA ON SUA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID=FEA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID JOIN SYS_USER SU ON SU.USER_ID=SUA.USER_ID WHERE FOP.POSITION_CODE IN ('05220', '00120') AND FEA.COMPANY_ID=#{companyId}

SELECT SU.USER_NAME FROM SYS_USER SU LEFT JOIN SYS_USER_ALLOCATION SUA ON SU.USER_ID = SUA.USER_ID LEFT JOIN FND_EMPLOYEE_ASSIGNS FEA ON SUA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID = FEA.EMPLOYEE_ASSIGN_ID LEFT JOIN FND_ORG_POSITION FOP ON FEA.POSITION_ID = FOP.POSITION_ID WHERE FOP.POSITION_CODE = '00300'
SELECT UR.allocation_id FROM sys_user U LEFT JOIN SYS_USER_ALLOCATION UR ON UR.USER_ID = U.USER_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_ROLE_B R ON R.ROLE_ID = UR.ROLE_ID WHERE R.ROLE_CODE = #{roleCode}
